cobblemon_poketotem.configuration.title: Cobblemon PokeTotem Configuration
cobblemon_poketotem.configuration.permis: Permission levels for the commands provided by Cobblemon PokeTotem.
cobblemon_poketotem.configuration.totemt: Totem to Poke Redeem Command Permission Level
The permission level required to use the /totemtopoke-redeem command. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to use the command.
Totem to Poke Redeem Server Command Permission Level
The permission level required to use the /totemtopoke-redeem-server command. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to use the command.
cobblemon_poketotem.configuration.comman: The permission levels required to use the commands provided by Cobblemon PokeTotem. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than the specified value will be able to use the command.
cobblemon_poketotem.configuration.totemt: Totem to Poke Server Command Permission Level
The permission level required to use the /totemtopoke-server command. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to use the command.
cobblemon_poketotem.configuration.poketo: Poke to Totem Command Permission Level
The permission level required to use the /poketototem command. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to use the command.
Poke to Totem Server Command Permission Level
The permission level required to use the /poketototem-server command. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to use the command.
cobblemon_poketotem.configuration.totemt: Totem to Poke Command Permission Level
The permission level required to use the /totemtopoke command. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to use the command.
